target.title: fix(slack): pass upload timeoutMs through guarded fetch dispatcher floors
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Slack outbound file upload already built a 120s `AbortSignal` via `buildTimeoutAbortSignal`, but `fetchWithSsrFGuard` did not receive `timeoutMs`. Guarded Undici dispatchers only apply connect/headers floors when `timeoutMs` is set; with signal alone, a peer that accepts TCP and never returns headers can hang until OS timeouts instead of failing on the shared transport floor. Sibling Feishu streaming-card / memory remote HTTP already pass both.

Open [#105893](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/105893) only times out startup `auth.test`; it does not touch upload.

## Why This Change Was Made

Forward the existing upload budget into the guarded fetch:

```ts
timeoutMs: SLACK_UPLOAD_POST_TIMEOUT_MS,
```

No new config/env surface. AbortSignal composition and completion-dispatch safety comments stay unchanged.

## User Impact

**Before:** A hung Slack upload peer could stall the byte-upload path beyond the intended 120s transport floor when only AbortSignal was wired.

**After:** Upload uses the same 120s budget for both AbortSignal and Undici connect/headers floors, so accept-then-hang peers fail closed via the guarded dispatcher.

## Evidence

- Changed: `extensions/slack/src/client-delivery.ts`
- Production caller: `sendMessageSlack` file upload → `fetchWithSsrFGuard`
- Sibling: Feishu streaming-card / memory remote HTTP `timeoutMs` + signal
- Regression: `extensions/slack/src/send.upload.test.ts`

### Caller-path Vitest

```bash
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/slack/src/send.upload.test.ts --reporter=verbose
```

```text
 ✓ ... > uploads bytes to the presigned URL and completes with thread+caption
 ✓ ... > times out a hanging presigned URL upload
 ✓ ... > fails closed on a hung upload peer via guarded timeoutMs floor 89ms
 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  35 passed (35)
[test] passed 1 Vitest shard in 4.93s
```

## Real behavior proof

**Behavior or issue addressed:**
Slack upload omitted `timeoutMs` on `fetchWithSsrFGuard`, so Undici connect/headers floors were not applied despite a 120s AbortSignal.

**Canonical reachability path:**
`sendMessageSlack` → `client-delivery` upload POST → `fetchWithSsrFGuard(withTrustedEnvProxyGuardedFetchMode(...))`

**Shared helper / provider constraint check:**
`fetchWithSsrFGuard` only passes dispatcher timeout when `params.timeoutMs` is set (`resolveDispatcherTimeoutMs`).

**Real environment tested:**
Local Vitest against a real loopback `node:http` server that accepts the upload request and never writes headers.

**Exact steps or command run after this patch:**
```bash
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/slack/src/send.upload.test.ts --reporter=verbose
```

**Evidence after fix:**
```text
 ✓ ... > fails closed on a hung upload peer via guarded timeoutMs floor 89ms
 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  35 passed (35)
[test] passed 1 Vitest shard in 4.93s
```

**Observed result after fix:**
Production path passes `timeoutMs: 120_000`. Against a hung peer, the guarded dispatcher fails closed in ~80ms when the proof substitutes that short stand-in (production floor remains 120s).

**What was not tested:**
Live Slack files API credentials; full 120s production floor duration.

**Fix classification:**
bug fix — wire existing timeout budget into guarded fetch dispatcher floors
